documents.doc-cz-rrtv-2026-09-01-rrtv-8853-2026-bu: On 1 September 2026, the Council for Radio and Television Broadcasting, under ref. RRTV/8853/2026-bur and case file RRTV/2026/560/kar, shelved the filing concerning Czech Television’s reporting on cannabis without opening misdemeanor proceedings. The Council found that the filing referred to an unspecified part of Czech Television’s programming and contained no facts actionable within its supervisory competence. Its notice states that no court action may be filed against the decision under Section 66 of Act No. 231/2001.
